integrity: The table is an exhaustively enumerated finite theorem, not an extrapolation. The standard qubit cut-rank theorem, qudit graph-state construction, and the previously known special alternating-cut result are credited; the claim is the full fifteen-class Smith distribution and uniqueness among all cuts. Independent external validation and exhaustive historical priority have not been established.
scientific_limitations: Exactly the sixteen-vertex Möbius–Kantor graph, pure prime-dimensional unit-weight graph states and unordered balanced eight-versus-eight bipartitions; not composite-dimensional, noisy or nonuniform networks. Entire integral classification is finite exact-computation assisted and separately cross-checked.
title: Complete arithmetic entanglement census for the Möbius–Kantor graph state
